name: HarkinianPad
game: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time (N64) via Ship of Harkinian

inputs.description: Your own supported Ocarina of Time ROM, chosen in the app. The build does not read it.

tools.name: cmake
tools.note: Install CMake 3.26 or newer: brew install cmake. The native Mac archive build also needs the host libraries listed in the pkgconf setup note.

tools.name: xcodebuild
tools.note: Install full Xcode and its iOS platform (Command Line Tools alone are not enough). Complete first-launch setup, then select Xcode in Xcode > Settings > Locations > Command Line Tools.

tools.name: xcrun
tools.label: Xcode iOS SDK
tools.note: Install full Xcode and its iOS platform (Command Line Tools alone are not enough). Complete first-launch setup, then select Xcode in Xcode > Settings > Locations > Command Line Tools.

tools.name: pkgconf
tools.note: Native Mac archive setup: brew install pkgconf sdl2 glew libzip nlohmann-json tinyxml2 libpng libogg libvorbis opus opusfile. This check verifies pkgconf only, not library readiness.

publication.reason: The app is compiled from the Ship of Harkinian decompilation; public releases are source only.
